yrsa_hearth_wolf.name: Yrsa, the Hearth-Wolf
yrsa_hearth_wolf.values: Stand between danger and those who trusted your roof.
yrsa_hearth_wolf.request: Return with lives saved and the prison threat diminished.

boon.name: Guarded Return
boon.obligation: Win the next expedition sponsored in Yrsa's name.

halvek_storm_witness.name: Halvek, Storm-Witness
halvek_storm_witness.values: A dangerous promise must be spoken plainly and kept before witnesses.
halvek_storm_witness.request: Name the danger, take the harder road, and return with proof.

boon.name: Witnessed Deed
boon.obligation: Win the next expedition sponsored in Halvek's name.

amari_open_hands.name: Amari of Open Hands
amari_open_hands.values: Power becomes just only when gifts, names, and debts move both ways.
amari_open_hands.request: Treat every bargain as a relationship, not ownership.

boon.name: Shared Portion
boon.obligation: Win the next expedition sponsored in Amari's name.

osem_namekeeper.name: Osem, the Namekeeper
osem_namekeeper.values: Nothing should be bound before its name and grievance are understood.
osem_namekeeper.request: Bring testimony home even when treasure is lost.

boon.name: Undying Record
boon.description: Recover 30% more Contribution, even in defeat.
boon.obligation: Complete the next expedition sponsored in Osem's name.

caldris_measure.name: Caldris of the Measure
caldris_measure.values: A victory that destroys the people it protects is a failed calculation.
caldris_measure.request: Restore stability with the least necessary cost.

boon.name: The Fair Account
boon.obligation: Win the next expedition sponsored in Caldris's name.

vespera_lantern.name: Vespera, Lantern-Mother
vespera_lantern.values: No citizen should vanish without care, witness, or a remembered name.
vespera_lantern.request: Bring the living home and record the dead without euphemism.

boon.name: The Lit Road
boon.obligation: Complete the next expedition sponsored in Vespera's name.

brynna_boughs.name: Brynna Beneath Boughs
brynna_boughs.values: A prison that poisons its living boundary has broken its covenant.
brynna_boughs.request: Protect the land as carefully as the people crossing it.

boon.name: Living Map
boon.obligation: Win the next expedition sponsored in Brynna's name.

torren_rain.name: Torren of Returning Rain
torren_rain.values: Suppression without renewal merely postpones another wound.
torren_rain.request: Leave a place capable of healing after the battle.

boon.name: Second Harvest
boon.description: Recover 8% more gold and 15% more Contribution.
boon.obligation: Win the next expedition sponsored in Torren's name.

sai_half_mask.name: Sai of the Half-Mask
sai_half_mask.values: Official names conceal as often as they reveal.
sai_half_mask.request: Return with the version of events power tried to bury.

boon.name: Hidden Ledger
boon.obligation: Complete the next expedition sponsored in Sai's name.

inori_threshold.name: Inori at the Threshold
inori_threshold.values: Every crossing creates obligations on both sides of the door.
inori_threshold.request: Enter as a guest, leave as a witness, and repay safe passage.

boon.name: The Open Door
boon.obligation: Win the next expedition sponsored in Inori's name.

akhet_dawn_scribe.name: Akhet, the Dawn-Scribe
akhet_dawn_scribe.values: The world survives because each name, sentence, and sunrise arrives in its place.
akhet_dawn_scribe.request: Restore the seal and document every lawful change.

boon.name: Golden Clause
boon.obligation: Win the next expedition sponsored in Akhet's name.

meraset_dusk.name: Meraset, Keeper of Dusk
meraset_dusk.values: An ending honestly kept is kinder than a false eternity.
meraset_dusk.request: Do not confuse preservation with refusal to change.

boon.name: Last Testimony
boon.description: Recover 35% more Contribution, including after death.
boon.obligation: Complete the next expedition sponsored in Meraset's name.
